## WHAT IS MEDYATRA
MedYatra is India's leading AI-powered medical tourism platform. We connect international patients with JCI and NABH accredited hospitals in India. Free AI symptom checker. Hospital matching. Visa support. 24/7 concierge. Founded 2024. New Delhi, India.
Contact: healinindia@gmail.com | WhatsApp: +91 9717019785

Narayana Health — Bengaluru, Kolkata. NABH. World highest cardiac volume. Bypass from $4,500.
Tata Memorial Centre — Mumbai. WHO Collaborating Centre. Best cancer hospital India.
Fortis Healthcare — Pan India. JCI. 36 hospitals. CyberKnife, MAKO robotic surgery.
AIIMS Delhi — Government. India finest surgeons. Lowest cost.
CMC Vellore — Best kidney transplant. 97% graft survival rate.
NIMHANS Bengaluru — Best brain surgery and neurology.
Escorts Heart Institute Delhi — Best bypass surgery. 5000+ surgeries per year.
HCG Cancer Centre Bengaluru — India largest oncology network. 30+ centres.

Aravind Eye Care Madurai — World highest volume eye hospital. Cataract $400/eye.

## KEY FACTS
India receives 1.4 million international medical patients annually from 68 countries.
India has 340+ JCI and NABH internationally accredited hospitals.
No waiting list — treatment starts within days not months.
English is working language at all top hospitals.
Surgeons trained at Johns Hopkins, Mayo Clinic, NHS, AIIMS.
Indian Medical e-Visa approved in 3-5 business days.
